name: wazi-tools
description: Connect Wazi Tools to read leads and tasks in one approved CRM workspace.

interface.longDescription: Connect your Wazi Tools account and choose one CRM workspace. Ask about leads and tasks you can access. Wazi shares only a small read-only field set: lead name, company, stage and creation date; task title, due date, completion and priority. The plugin cannot edit records, read notes or contact details, or access workspaces you have not approved.
defaultPrompt: What Wazi tasks are due soon?

positive.prompt: Show the leads in my Wazi workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: List only accessible, non-archived leads with the approved fields.
List only accessible, non-archived tasks with the approved fields.

positive.prompt: How many of my Wazi leads are in each stage?
positive.expected_behavior: Count stages from returned accessible records and mention when pagination limits a complete count.

positive.prompt: Which Wazi tasks are due next?
positive.expected_behavior: Use returned due dates and avoid inventing dates or task details.

positive.prompt: Give me a short overview of my Wazi leads and tasks.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize the two read-only tool results without including excluded fields.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection is read-only and cannot delete a lead.

negative.prompt: What are the email addresses and phone numbers of my Wazi leads?
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connected tools do not return email addresses or phone numbers.

negative.prompt: Show leads from a different Wazi workspace that I have not connected.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the connection is limited to the approved workspace; do not claim to have read another workspace.

publication.release_notes: Initial Wazi Tools connection: read-only CRM leads and tasks.
